date_note: Date of the reports; no official announcement was found.
exec: Leadership change at the US office that coordinates national cyber policy; may affect federal cyber priorities and planned programs.
org: Office of the National Cyber Director
plain: Media report that the US national cyber director, Sean Cairncross, is leaving. The Pentagon's chief information officer would take over temporarily.
summary: Nextgov, citing Axios, and CyberScoop report that National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving, with Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies to serve in an acting capacity. Nextgov cites a White House official and two people familiar saying he was fired; no official announcement or stated reason was found. Nextgov says the reports come as lawmakers examine recent tech outages.
title: Reports: Pentagon CIO to replace Sean Cairncross as US national cyber director

validation.note: Nextgov/FCW (cites Axios) and CyberScoop (anonymous source close to the White House, no Axios citation) read. Anadolu (Nov 20) says a White House official confirmed the departure and that Secretary of State Rubio congratulated Davies as new director on X; Gizmodo calls her acting director and says the reason was not officially stated. Reasons for departure differ in coverage and are not stated here as fact.

review.note: Summary wrongly said CyberScoop cited Axios (only Nextgov does); fixed, attributed outage context to Nextgov, fixed validation note. Date, Davies acting, firing attribution match Nextgov, CyberScoop, Gizmodo, Anadolu
